scope: Reverse-engineering evidence for core-story building/facility placement and build lifecycle. No Godot scene/build or game execution.

evidence_legend.EF: EventFlow graph/source reference; proves the graph contains the named flow action/query/parameter/flag, not its runtime handler result.
evidence_legend.TBL: Raw table row/field evidence from B_data BCSV.
evidence_legend.STRUCT: Parsed source structure evidence from stage or BYML data; does not establish a semantic actor or runtime consumer join by itself.
evidence_legend.PSEUDO: Static pseudocode/disassembly summary; not a native execution unless explicitly said otherwise.
evidence_legend.NATIVE: Bounded execution of original native instructions under the recorded fixture; no building-placement lifecycle was run in this workstream.
evidence_legend.CAT: Name/metadata catalogue candidate only. Never evidence of selected runtime model, mesh, waveform, or collision shape.

provenance.source_inventory_basis: Raw B_data paths and hashes are from this checkout manifest; source_id is the manifest entry id. BFEVFL/BCSV/BYML resolved output views were read from the existing analysis workspace; raw source hashes are retained here to make the relation reproducible.

decoders.role: BFEVFL structural parser; EventFlow event/actor/parameter references.
Static EventFlow graph export; parser validation is structural, not handler runtime proof.
BCSV rows/fields; preserve row UniqueID and table namespace; unresolved hash columns are not renamed by assumption.
BCSV/BYML export; binary BYML blobs stay external and are referenced as blobs.
Typed BYML view; retains wire tags/raw values where available.
Descriptor recovery; @field names are recovered hash-key annotations and the raw hash/key remains the source authority.
Prior field exporter; its assumptions describe terrain preset derivation and retain raw cells; not used as a building placement proof.
Tracks imported parser code and local changes, including f32 EventFlow precision.

provenance.namespace_rule: Do not compare numeric keys across ItemParam.UniqueID, StructureInfoParam.UniqueID, StructureFacilityModel.UniqueID, StructureBridgeTypeParam.UniqueID, StructureBridgeParam.UniqueID, StructureHouseShapeParam.UniqueID, SettlerType, StructureType, save flags, or grid coordinates. Each value is qualified with its source namespace.
provenance.coordinate_rule: BYML mUnitX/Z values in StructurePreset are cell indices. No scale/origin/axis/rotation/elevation conversion is claimed. Preset LandMaking cells, stage-local @Pos values and structure placement instance transforms remain distinct until a native consumer and join are proven.
provenance.asset_rule: Model/audio catalogue rows are CAT only. A table ModelName equal to a catalogue Asset_ID is a candidate lookup, not proof of raw asset availability, selected resource, rendered mesh, audio playback, or collider binding.

StructurePresetA00 mSiteList cells are known but are not assigned to player house, initial NPC houses, facilities, bridges or quest plots.
No confirmed origin/scale/axis/rotation/elevation transform from template cell coordinates to runtime world coordinates.

EventFlow contains CanBuildHere, HasObstacle and StructureStartPreviewGuide calls. No full handler/native run ties parameters to accepted footprint or placement state.
No structure footprint, collider, PBC file, terrain collision response or overlap geometry has been joined to these building classes.
Facility table ModelName and catalog Asset_ID matches remain CAT; raw model bytes and runtime resource consumer are absent from this proof.
EventFlow gives furniture requirements and donation/check flags, but no saved object instance transform or exact interior/exterior placement cells are linked.
MainFieldDemoFirstLive has an actor record with a position, but ActorName/model/role/camera/collider bindings remain unresolved.
The cited flow unlocks recipe reference 2615; output item, equipment state, traversal handler and collider usage are not joined here.
